purpose: A scheme-scoped wildcard host allows every HTTPS origin, so default-src is effectively unrestricted and must be reported.

groundTruth.rationale: https://* is a host-source whose host is the wildcard, which matches every host over HTTPS. It permits the same origins as a bare wildcard for secure pages.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live page.
A scoped wildcard such as https://*.example.com is a different expression and is not reported by this rule.
